## Hypothesis

The shotgun_scalper_stage5 candidate aims to capture explosive intraday momentum by tightening the volume filter on TRENDLINE_BREAK_RETEST setups to 2.0x 20-bar average volume (vs 1.5x in TBR_HIGH_VOL). This targets only the most conviction breaks, reducing false positives while maintaining edge on genuine momentum days. The hypothesis exists because low-volume breaks often fail (liquidity sweeps), while high-volume breaks align with institutional participation and sustained follow-through.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** TRENDLINE_BREAK_RETEST signal (price breaks trendline, retests within $0.20, closes above/below) with volume ≥ 2.0x 20-bar average volume. Direction determined by trendline slope (downtrend for puts, uptrend for calls).  
**Exit:** Chart stop at trendline ± $0.50 buffer (primary), TP1 at +50% premium (sell 2/3), runner trails to breakeven after TP1, secondary exit on 3-bar EMA re-entry or premium ≥ 3x. Time stop 15:50 ET.
